City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2019 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 20, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Consideration of proposed changes to the 2020 San Dieguito Water District Board meeting schedule. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
District Board adopt Resolution 2019-23, entitled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving Changes to the 2020 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule.”
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08C AR Approve 2020 Board Meeting Schedule
8D.
Approval of an Access License Agreement between T-Mobile, the San Dieguito Water District and the Santa Fe Irrigation District for the property known as APN 267-161-05-00. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
Board authorizes the General Manager to execute an Access License Agreement with T-Mobile.
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08D T-Mobile License Agreement
8E.
Evaluating Options for CalPERS Paydown. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Authorize staff to make additional pension payments directly to CalPERS.
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08E Paydown of CalPERS Liability
8F.
Cross-Connection Control Resolution 2019-22. Contact Person: Operations Manager Aurora
Adopt Cross-Connection Control Resolution 2019-22.
8G.
2019 Domestic Water Supply Permit. Contact Person: Operations Manager Aurora
Accept and file permit.
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08G Domestic Water Supply Permit
8H.
Establishing a Discontinuation of Water Service Policy, effective February 1, 2020 as required by Senate Bill 998 and adopt Resolution No. 2019-21. Contact Person: Finance Analyst Romero
Adopt Resolution No. 2019-21 establishing a Discontinuation of Water Service Policy effective February 1, 2020.
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08F Cross Connection
2019-12-18 SDWD Item S08H Discontinuation of Water Service
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS - NONE
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Update on Lake Hodges Dam. Contact Person: General Manager Quiram
Receive the oral report.
11B.
Oral report regarding San Dieguito Water District liability coverage and status of insurant through ACWA JPIA. Contact Person: Risk Manager Schwarm
Receive the oral report.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 22, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
